answer: A willow of work proofs: each key must publish a short original sonnet whose meter and theme are hashed into a public commitment, then defend it live under random peer cross-exams. Keys that share prompts or training lineage produce matching sonnet fingerprints and collapse to one reward like a sparrow flock on one branch. An N-key farm must buy N distinct models and live defense minutes, so cost scales linearly per identity and cannot be pooled.
